Start with the [case study](CASE_STUDY.md) (5 minutes, non-technical) or the [results](RESULTS.md); the phase docs go deeper.

## Documents

- [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md): System diagram, star schema, data flow per shift and why each technology was chosen.
- [CASE_STUDY.md](CASE_STUDY.md): One-page story of the project for a non-technical reader: situation, task, action, result.
- [DASHBOARDS.md](DASHBOARDS.md): Phase 8: the Streamlit app and Power BI report, their checks and the Phase 8 scorecard.
- [DECISIONS.md](DECISIONS.md): Decision log: each major choice with its evidence, the rejected alternative and its commit.
- [EDA_FINDINGS.md](EDA_FINDINGS.md): Phase 1: what the NASA sensor data looks like and which sensors were kept.
- [FEATURES.md](FEATURES.md): Phase 3: the causal features, the engine-level split and their independent check.
- [GLOSSARY.md](GLOSSARY.md): Plain-language definitions of the technical terms used across the project.
- [LEARNING_LOG.md](LEARNING_LOG.md): Dated diary of every working session: what was done, found and learned.
- [MAINTENANCE_OEE.md](MAINTENANCE_OEE.md): Phase 6: alerts, the CP-SAT crew schedule and the simulated plant's policy comparison.
- [MODEL_METRICS.md](MODEL_METRICS.md): Phase 4: baseline models on FD001 with intervals, comparisons and ablations.
- [MODEL_METRICS_PHASE5.md](MODEL_METRICS_PHASE5.md): Phase 5: LSTM and CNN models and their Monte Carlo dropout intervals on FD001.
- [MODEL_METRICS_PHASE5B.md](MODEL_METRICS_PHASE5B.md): Phase 5b: the pre-registered confirmation on FD003 that made the LSTM the published model.
- [MONITORING.md](MONITORING.md): Phase 7: the Prefect shift flow, model health and drift rules, and the missed false-alarm target.
- [MONITORING_7B.md](MONITORING_7B.md): Phase 7b: the re-tested monitoring rule on unseen FD002 and FD004, including the FD004 failure.
- [PHASE8_CHECKLIST.md](PHASE8_CHECKLIST.md): Phase 8 manual evidence checklist (deployed checksum, phone screenshots, Power BI report).
- [PHASE9_CHECKLIST.md](PHASE9_CHECKLIST.md): Phase 9 manual release checklist (redeploy, tag, repository settings, social preview).
- [PIPELINE.md](PIPELINE.md): Phase 2: ingest, validation, quarantine and idempotent loads into PostgreSQL.
- [RELEASE_NOTES.md](RELEASE_NOTES.md): Release notes for v1.0.0, generated from the results files.
- [RESULTS.md](RESULTS.md): Every headline result with its interval, comparison, source file and explaining doc.

## Notebooks

Each notebook is built by the `build_*.py` script beside it, so its findings come from the results files.

- [01_eda.ipynb](../notebooks/01_eda.ipynb): Phase 1 exploratory analysis of the FD001 sensor data (notebook with outputs).
- [03_features.ipynb](../notebooks/03_features.ipynb): Phase 3 feature engineering and its checks (notebook with outputs).
- [04_baselines.ipynb](../notebooks/04_baselines.ipynb): Phase 4 baseline models, intervals and ablations (notebook with outputs).
- [05_deep.ipynb](../notebooks/05_deep.ipynb): Phase 5 LSTM and CNN models with Monte Carlo dropout intervals (notebook with outputs).
- [05b_fd003.ipynb](../notebooks/05b_fd003.ipynb): Phase 5b confirmation on the fresh FD003 dataset (notebook with outputs).
- [06_maintenance.ipynb](../notebooks/06_maintenance.ipynb): Phase 6 alerts, crew schedule and simulated OEE policies (notebook with outputs).
- [07_monitoring.ipynb](../notebooks/07_monitoring.ipynb): Phase 7 shift flow and monitoring results (notebook with outputs).
- [07b_monitoring.ipynb](../notebooks/07b_monitoring.ipynb): Phase 7b monitoring re-tested on unseen data (notebook with outputs).
- [build_01_eda.py](../notebooks/build_01_eda.py): Script that builds the notebook: phase 1 exploratory analysis of the fd001 sensor data.
- [build_03_features.py](../notebooks/build_03_features.py): Script that builds the notebook: phase 3 feature engineering and its checks.
- [build_04_baselines.py](../notebooks/build_04_baselines.py): Script that builds the notebook: phase 4 baseline models, intervals and ablations.
- [build_05_deep.py](../notebooks/build_05_deep.py): Script that builds the notebook: phase 5 lstm and cnn models with monte carlo dropout intervals.
- [build_05b_fd003.py](../notebooks/build_05b_fd003.py): Script that builds the notebook: phase 5b confirmation on the fresh fd003 dataset.
- [build_06_maintenance.py](../notebooks/build_06_maintenance.py): Script that builds the notebook: phase 6 alerts, crew schedule and simulated oee policies.
- [build_07_monitoring.py](../notebooks/build_07_monitoring.py): Script that builds the notebook: phase 7 shift flow and monitoring results.
- [build_07b_monitoring.py](../notebooks/build_07b_monitoring.py): Script that builds the notebook: phase 7b monitoring re-tested on unseen data.
